summary: Tu Weiming works in philosophy, sinology, and religious studies. He studied at Tunghai University, Tokai University, and Harvard under Mou Zongsan, Chun-i Tang, and Fuguan Xu. He held posts at Princeton, UC Berkeley, Harvard (1981–2010), and Peking University (~2010).
Tubten Gyeltsen Ozer studied under Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Thayé, Patrul Rinpoche, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo.
Tubten Nyendrak studied under Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Thayé and Shenphen Nangwa.
Tubten Nyima studied under Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.
Tubten Tsondru studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, and Khenpo Gangshar.
Tukaram Laddu worked in Indology and linguistics. He studied at the University of Halle until 1912 and held a post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1920).
Tulku Hungkar Dorje studied under Penor Rinpoche and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.

Tulku Sherdor works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Vassar College, Naropa University, and the University of Virginia, and under Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Ted Norton, and Jeffrey Hopkins.

Tulku Thondup was a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied at Dodrupchen Monastery and under Kyala Khenpo, Khenpo Chemchok, and Dodrupchen Rinpoche. He held a post as a visiting scholar at Harvard University.

Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under Samten Gyatso (~1933–1940), Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Karsé Kongtrul, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.

Turrell V. Wylie worked in Tibetology and sinology. He studied at the University of Washington (~1948–1958) and under Giuseppe Tucci and Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima, holding faculty posts at the University of Washington from 1957 onward.
Tutob Chökyi Wangchuk studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, and Trulshik Rinpoche.
Tyler Dewar works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at the Nitartha Institute and under Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche, Acharya Lama Tenpa Gyaltsen, and Acharya Tashi Wangchuk.
Tyler G. Neill is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. He completed his PhD at the University of Leipzig by 2022 and held an attested post there in 2022.

Tzungkuen Wen works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He completed a PhD at the University of Queensland (–2009) and held posts at Fuyan Buddhist Institute (2005) and Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Studies (attested 2026).
U Dhammissara works in Buddhist studies. He studied at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University for a Master of Arts under Sanu Mahatthanadull (attested 2017).
Ugyen Pelgen works in Tibetology and history/archaeology. He completed a master's degree at Aligarh Muslim University and served as a lecturer of history at Sherubtse College.

Ulrich Pagel works in Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied under Tadeusz Skorupski, Philip Denwood, and Renate Söhnen-Thieme, and held a post at SOAS University of London (attested 2013–2020).

Ulrich Timme Kragh works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. He studied at the Karmapa International Buddhist Institute and University of Copenhagen, holding posts at Geumgang University, IIAS, and Copenhagen (attested 2002, ~2013–2017).

Ulrich von Wilamowitz-Moellendorff was a scholar of linguistics and history/archaeology. He studied at Schulpforta, Bonn, and Berlin under Otto Jahn, Moriz Haupt, and others. He held professorial posts at Greifswald (1876–1883), Göttingen (1883–1897), and Berlin (1897–1921).
